result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but a few elements appear visibly clipped or incomplete, reducing polish and potentially obscuring content.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the next restaurant card; its image is visibly cut off behind the navigation bar at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable feed or reserve space for the fixed navigation so cards can scroll fully above it.

issues.description: The circular control in the top-right header appears empty, showing only a red notification dot without a visible profile, account, or menu icon.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon/avatar in the control, or remove the notification indicator if there is no associated action.

issues.description: The horizontal category row ends with a partially visible, unlabeled pill on the right, making the row look clipped rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Provide clearer horizontal-scroll affordance, such as consistent partial visibility with a fade/arrow, and ensure the next chip label is not reduced to a blank sliver.
